classification: Independent local-file analysis; analyst accessed no capture device or kit

fixture.note: Original graphics cartridge with appended DI/stack/SN tone trampoline; original absolute table addresses are preserved.

limitations: Full-raster scanline RTL shades alternating HDMI rows; each native source line is doubled vertically, so its two HDMI rows have different brightness.
The full-pixel grid oracle includes the existing shell framebuffer read latency of one HDMI pixel horizontally, while retaining viewport x384:896/y168:552.
Leading acquisition frames and half-second audio acquisition windows are reported separately; comparisons use the explicit common settled audio window.
USB frame timestamps do not measure FPGA HS/VS waveforms directly. Capture RGB conversion and audio filtering/rescaling prevent bit-exact FPGA RGB/PCM claims.
All strongest spectral peaks are measured without nominal-frequency filtering; the target peak additionally must be near the fixture nominal and have at least half the strongest peak power.
